admin_accounts_description: A deactivated account can no longer sign in, and its sessions end at once. Its ratings and contributions stay.
admin_action_element_same_as_added: Marked as the same as another element
admin_action_group_check_asked: Participants asked to check the groups
admin_action_rater_group_joined: Facilitator joined a group to rate
admin_action_scope_sources_reordered: Scope sources put in a new order
admin_action_value_list_added: Value list added to a round
admin_action_value_list_applied: Result of a value round applied to a proposal
admin_action_value_list_removed: Value list taken out of a round
admin_activity_description: Newest first, {size} entries per page. The log holds actions, projects and names, never content.
admin_activity_empty: The log has no entries for this action.
admin_deactivate_body: The account is signed out everywhere and can no longer sign in. You can reactivate it later.
admin_grant_email_invalid: Enter an e-mail address such as name@example.org.
admin_purpose: Manage accounts, the administrator role and the right to create projects.
admin_reactivated: The account of {email} can sign in again.
admin_rights_caption: E-mail addresses with an application right
admin_rights_description: An administrator manages accounts and rights. A facilitator may create projects. A right belongs to an e-mail address, also before it has an account.
app_description: Agree on the data elements of a clinical model, from scope to hand-off.
board_add_description: A name and a description are enough. The data type and the cardinality follow in a later phase.
board_brainstorm_purpose_private: The dashed cards come from existing models. Add what your group records that is not there yet. Only you see your cards until the facilitator reveals the board.
board_brainstorm_purpose_shared: The dashed cards come from existing models. Add what your group records that is not there yet. Everyone sees every card, without names.
board_cardinality_hint: How often the element occurs in one record, written as minimum..maximum, such as 0..1 or 1..*. Leave both open if the group decides later.
board_cardinality_incomplete: Choose both a minimum and a maximum, or leave both open.
board_check_already_done: You are done checking. You can still change your remarks while the facilitator works on the groups.
board_check_finished: Thank you. Your remarks are saved for the facilitator; other participants do not see them.
board_check_missing_saved: Your remark is saved for the facilitator.
board_check_not_asked: The facilitator has not asked to check the groups yet.
board_check_purpose: The facilitator grouped the list. Mark an element that is the same as another, or that belongs in a different group, and say if something is missing. Leave the rest as it is.
board_ckm_link_description: Find the archetype, open it and pick the element that means the same.
board_ckm_no_results: CKM found no archetypes for this search text.
board_ckm_search_description: Words in the archetype's name, such as blood pressure.
board_column_hidden: {count} from others, hidden until the reveal
board_csv_file_duplicate_column: The header row names a column twice.
board_csv_file_missing_description_colum: The header row has no description column.
board_csv_file_missing_name_column: The header row has no name column.
board_csv_file_not_utf8: The file is not in UTF-8. Save it as CSV UTF-8 and try again.
board_csv_file_too_large: The file is larger than 1 MiB.
board_csv_file_too_many_rows: The file has more than {max} rows.
board_csv_file_unterminated_quote: A quoted field is not closed.
board_csv_row_cardinality_invalid: The cardinality is not written as 0..1, 1..1, 0..* or 1..*.
board_csv_row_data_type_unknown: The data type is not in the list.
board_csv_row_field_count: The row has another number of fields than the header.
board_csv_row_malformed_quotes: The row has text after a closing quote.
board_data_type_hint: Pick the type that fits the value, or leave it as not decided. Each option shows the openEHR type and the FHIR type.
board_data_type_none_help: The group chooses the type later.
board_description_description: What the element records, in plain words. At most {max} characters.
board_duplicates_help: Members marked these pairs as the same. Merge a pair if you agree; a mark decides nothing by itself.
board_edit_description: Change the wording, the data type or the cardinality. The comments and sources stay.
board_empty_description: The elements from the brainstorm show here.
board_first_look_empty: The facilitator has not put elements from existing models on the list yet. You can add what you think the concept needs.
board_first_look_purpose: Existing models already describe these elements. Say for each one whether it belongs to the concept {concept}, as the scope describes it. This is a first look, not a vote; the group rates the list in Decide.
board_first_look_question: Does this element belong to the concept {concept}?
board_grouping_add_description: The new group comes after the others, empty. Move elements into it.
board_grouping_asked: Participants are asked to check the groups.
board_grouping_checking: Asked to check: {checked} of {participants} participants are done.
board_grouping_held: {name} picked up. Choose Move here in a group, or press Escape.
board_grouping_purpose: Each element starts in a group: the question it was added under, or its place in the existing model. Drag the ones that are in the wrong place, or click one and choose Move here. Rename or add a group if the concept needs it. Participants check the result.
board_grouping_rounds_note: The groups become headings in round 1. Each participant sees the groups in a different order, so no group always comes first.
board_hints_help: Open one to read it or comment on it, instead of adding a duplicate.
board_hints_help_same: Open one to read it. Or choose "Same as this": you support that element, and what you typed is not added.
board_hints_marked_same: You support {name}. Nothing new was added.
board_hints_title: Similar elements already on the board: {count}
board_import_file_description: A CSV file in UTF-8 with a header row. The columns name and description are required, data_type and cardinality are optional. Comma or semicolon separated, at most 1 MiB and {rows} rows.
board_import_purpose: Add candidate elements from a CSV file. You see every row before anything is added.
board_marks_help: Other participants never see your marks. The facilitator sees only the numbers and decides on merges.
board_max_number_invalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
board_merge_description: The element you keep gets the descriptions, sources, comments and proposed values of the duplicates. The duplicates leave the board.
board_merge_from_too_many: Choose at most {max} duplicates at a time.
board_merge_into_description: Its name, data type and cardinality stay.
board_models_add_description: Search openEHR CKM or a FHIR package, or add another source by title and link.
board_models_added: Model added. Its elements are in the table below.
board_models_all_listed: Every element is on the list.
board_models_base_cleared: {title} is no longer the base model.
board_models_base_set: {title} is now the base model. Rows it lacks show what the other models add.
board_models_coverage_intro: Elements are matched by their code first, then by a known mapping, then by name. A match by mapping or name is a suggestion: choose Not the same to split it. Then pick which rows go on the list.
board_models_link_description: A web address where others can read the source.
board_models_link_invalid: Enter a link that starts with http:// or https://.
board_models_purpose: Import the models that already describe {project}. Their elements become the start of the list, so nobody has to type them again.
board_name_description: A short name, such as Systolic pressure. At most {max} characters.
board_name_required: Enter a name for the element.
board_private_participant_note: Private step: you see only your own elements until the facilitator reveals the board.
board_private_status: Private step: participants see only their own elements. Participants with elements: {participants} of {total}. Elements: {elements}.
board_prompt_context: In which situation or for which use is it recorded?
board_prompt_method: How was it measured: method, device or position?
board_prompt_patient_state: What about the patient do you need to know to interpret it?
board_prompt_recorded: What do you record or measure?
board_purpose: The candidate elements of the concept, with their sources and comments.
board_reference_title_description: The whole model this element stands for, such as a zib, an archetype or a profile. At most {max} characters.
board_reference_title_required: Give the title of the model.
board_reference_url_invalid: Give a web address that starts with http:// or https://, of at most {max} characters.
board_reveal_confirm_description: Everyone then sees every element, without the name of who added it. You cannot make the board private again.
board_reveal_confirm_title: Reveal the board to all participants?
board_reveal_in_discover: You can reveal the board in the Discover phase. Opening a round also reveals it.
board_revealed: The board is revealed. Participants now see every element.
board_same_as_added: You marked {name} as the same as {other}.
board_same_as_description: Choose another element that says the same, so the facilitator can merge them.
board_same_as_removed: Your mark that {name} is the same as {other} is removed.
board_same_as_required: Choose the element that says the same.
board_same_as_yours: You marked this as the same as:
board_suggest_description: Name a model, form or guideline that already describes the concept. The facilitator decides whether to import it.
board_suggest_sent: Thank you. The facilitator will look at your suggestion.
board_type_boolean_help: A true yes or no answer. Word the question so that only yes or no can be the answer. Not for lists such as male or female: use coded text for those.
board_type_coded_text_help: A value from a fixed list or a terminology, such as SNOMED CT. Not for a code attached to free text: use text for that.
board_type_count_help: A whole number without a unit, such as the number of pregnancies or cigarettes a day. Not for amounts of physical things, which have a unit.
board_type_date_help: A calendar date, also a partial one, such as an approximate date of birth with only the year and month.
board_type_date_time_help: A point in time with a date and a time, such as the moment of a measurement.
board_type_date_time_interval_help: A period between two points in time, with a start and an end.
board_type_duration_help: A length of time, such as 3 days or 2 hours. Not for a point in time or a period between two dates.
board_type_identifier_help: An identifier issued by an authority, such as a prescription number or an order number. Not for the ids a computer system makes for its own records.
board_type_multimedia_help: An image, a sound or video recording, or a bio-signal such as an ECG.
board_type_ordinal_help: A score from a short ordered list, with a whole number and a symbol, such as the Apgar score or a urine strip result (neg, trace, +, ++). The steps need not be equal.
board_type_proportion_help: A ratio of two numbers, such as a titre (1:128), the albumin to creatinine ratio or a percentage. Not for blood pressure or visual acuity (6/24): they are written with a slash but are not ratios.
board_type_quantity_help: A measured amount with a unit in UCUM, such as 120 mm[Hg] or 70 kg.
board_type_quantity_interval_help: A range of quantities with a lower and an upper limit, such as 10 to 20 mg.
board_type_scale_help: Like ordinal, but the score may have decimals, such as the Borg CR10 scale (0, 0.5, 1, 2).
board_type_text_help: Free text, from one word to several sentences, such as a clinical note.
board_type_time_help: A time of day without a date, such as the time a medicine was taken.
board_type_uri_help: A link to a resource elsewhere, such as a web page.
board_value_number_invalid: Enter a number, such as 2 or 0.5.
board_value_text_required: Enter a text for the value.
board_values_description: The ordered values of {name} ({type}). An ordinal value needs a whole number, a scale value a number.
common_comment_description: Other participants do not see who wrote a comment; the facilitator does. At most {max} characters.
common_error_body: This page could not be loaded. Try again, or go back to your projects.
common_error_unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
common_not_found_body: This page does not exist, or you have no access to it.
common_refusal_already_invited: This e-mail address already has an open invitation to this project.
common_refusal_already_member: This person is already a member of the project.
common_refusal_board_already_revealed: The board has already been revealed. The private step cannot change any more.
common_refusal_ckm_element_not_found: This archetype element no longer exists in CKM.
common_refusal_ckm_reference: This element refers to a whole model, so it does not link to one archetype element.
common_refusal_ckm_refused: CKM refused the request. Try again later.
common_refusal_ckm_revision_changed: The archetype has a new revision in CKM. Open it again and check the element.
common_refusal_ckm_timeout: CKM took too long to answer. Try again later.
common_refusal_ckm_unreachable: CKM cannot be reached. Try again later.
common_refusal_ckm_unusable: CKM sent an answer this app cannot read.
common_refusal_closes_at_past: The closing date must be in the future.
common_refusal_detail_answer_not_found: This objection is gone or already part of a settled proposal. Reload the page.
common_refusal_detail_in_value_round: The values of this proposal are in a round that is not closed. Wait until the round is closed.
common_refusal_detail_not_architect: Only the facilitator and members of an architecture group propose the structure.
common_refusal_detail_not_in_model: This element is not in the model, so it gets no structure proposal.
common_refusal_detail_not_reviewed: These codes wait for review by a second terminologist.
common_refusal_detail_not_terminologist: Only the facilitator and members of a terminology group propose codes, and only a terminologist reviews them.
common_refusal_detail_objections_open: An objection is still open. Address every objection before you settle the proposal.
common_refusal_detail_proposal_not_found: This proposal does not exist (any more).
common_refusal_detail_reference_codes: This element refers to another model and takes its codes from that model, so it gets no code proposal.
common_refusal_detail_reference_structur: This element refers to another model, so its proposal has a cardinality only: no data type and no values.
common_refusal_detail_review_not_pending: These codes do not wait for a review now.
common_refusal_detail_review_own: You proposed these codes, so another terminologist reviews them.
common_refusal_detail_review_possible: Another terminologist can review these codes, so the review cannot be skipped.
common_refusal_detail_structure_open: Settle the structure of this element first; its codes follow.
common_refusal_detail_value_codes_mismat: The value list changed. Reload the page and give a code per value again.
common_refusal_detail_version_changed: Someone changed the proposal in the meantime. Reload the page and look at it again.
common_refusal_element_group_not_found: This group no longer exists. Reload the page and try again.
common_refusal_element_has_values: This element has proposed values that do not fit the new data type. Remove those values first.
common_refusal_element_in_round: One of these elements is in a rating round, so you cannot merge them.
common_refusal_element_kind_locked: This element has a proposal in the detail phase, so it cannot start or stop referring to another model.
common_refusal_element_not_found: This element no longer exists, or it was merged into another element.
common_refusal_element_not_in_round: This element is not part of this round.
common_refusal_fhir_no_snapshot: This StructureDefinition has no snapshot, so its elements cannot be read.
common_refusal_fhir_not_r4: This FHIR package is not for FHIR R4.
common_refusal_fhir_package_not_found: The registry has no FHIR package with this name or version.
common_refusal_fhir_refused: The FHIR package registry refused the request.
common_refusal_fhir_structure_not_found: This package has no StructureDefinition with that URL.
common_refusal_fhir_timeout: The FHIR package registry took too long to answer. Try again later.
common_refusal_fhir_too_large: This FHIR package is too large to read.
common_refusal_fhir_unreachable: The FHIR package registry cannot be reached. Try again later.
common_refusal_fhir_unusable: The FHIR package registry sent an answer the app cannot read.
common_refusal_forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
common_refusal_group_check_before_reveal: Reveal the board first: the check shows every element to every participant.
common_refusal_group_check_not_asked: The facilitator has not asked to check the groups yet.
common_refusal_group_name_taken: Another stakeholder group in this project already has this name.
common_refusal_group_not_empty: You can only remove a group without members and without open invitations.
common_refusal_group_not_found: This stakeholder group no longer exists.
common_refusal_groups_after_discover: The groups are fixed once the project has left Discover.
common_refusal_mail_not_configured: This server cannot send e-mail, so no reminder went out.
common_refusal_marks_before_reveal: You can mark elements after the facilitator reveals the board.
common_refusal_merge_before_reveal: These elements were added by different people. Merge them after you reveal the board, so no participant sees the words of another before then.
common_refusal_merge_kind_conflict: An element that refers to another model cannot merge with an ordinary element.
common_refusal_merge_values_conflict: The proposed values do not fit the data type of the element that stays.
common_refusal_minimum_reason_required: Give a reason for the project's own minimum.
common_refusal_model_type_after_discover: The model type is fixed once the project has left Discover.
common_refusal_no_next_phase: The project is already in its last phase.
common_refusal_no_previous_phase: The project is already in its first phase.
common_refusal_not_found: This does not exist, or you have no access to it.
common_refusal_own_account: You cannot do this with your own account.
common_refusal_panel_locked: The change class and the minimum panel are fixed once the first round has opened.
common_refusal_phase_changed: The phase changed in the meantime. Reload the page to see the current phase.
common_refusal_phase_closed: This step is closed in the current phase. You can still read it.
common_refusal_previous_round_not_closed: Close the previous round before you start a new one.
common_refusal_private_after_group_check: The participants were asked to check the groups and have seen every element, so the brainstorm cannot be private again.
common_refusal_proposal_already_on_board: This proposal is already on the board.
common_refusal_proposals_first_round_onl: Only round 1 takes proposals for missing elements.
common_refusal_rater_group_locked: A round is open. You can move to another group or leave your group once the round has closed.
common_refusal_rater_group_required: As facilitator you rate only as a member of a stakeholder group. Join a group on the members page first.
common_refusal_raters_hidden: This round does not show who gave which rating.
common_refusal_reason_required: The panel is below the minimum. Give a reason to open the round anyway.
common_refusal_recap_not_ready: This phase is not done yet, so it has no recap.
common_refusal_reference_data_type: An element that refers to another model has no data type of its own.
common_refusal_reminder_outside_discover: You can send a reminder in the Discover phase only.
common_refusal_reveal_outside_discover: You can reveal the board in the Discover phase only.
common_refusal_round_has_no_elements: Add at least one element to the round before you open it.
common_refusal_round_not_closed: The results show once the round is closed.
common_refusal_round_not_draft: This round has opened, so you can no longer change it.
common_refusal_round_not_due: You can close this round only after its closing date.
common_refusal_round_outside_decide: You can open a round in the Decide phase only. Move the project to Decide first.
common_refusal_round_outside_detail: You can open a value round in the Detail phase only. Move the project to Detail first.
common_refusal_round_still_open: A round is still open. Close it before you move the project to another phase.
common_refusal_rule_invalid: The consensus rule is not valid. Check its thresholds.
common_refusal_same_as_itself: An element cannot be the same as itself. Choose another element.
common_refusal_scope_source_order_mismat: The list of sources changed while you sorted it. Reload the page and try again.
common_refusal_score_out_of_scale: This score is outside the scale of the round.
common_refusal_source_after_discover: You can add or import source models until the Discover phase ends.
common_refusal_source_already_added: This source model is already in the project.
common_refusal_source_already_imported: The elements of this source model are already on the board.
common_refusal_source_base_not_in_table: Only a model with a column in the table can be the base model.
common_refusal_source_no_elements: This source model has no elements to import.
common_refusal_source_not_added: A suggestion has no elements to import. Add the model it names first.
common_refusal_source_not_found: This source model no longer exists.
common_refusal_source_not_suggested: This source model is no suggestion, or someone already decided on it.
common_refusal_source_row_not_found: This row is no longer in the table. Reload the page and try again.
common_refusal_source_row_not_suggested: Only a match by mapping or by name can be split. A match by element code always counts.
common_refusal_source_row_on_list: This row is already on the list, so you can no longer split it.
common_refusal_tree_cycle: A group cannot sit inside itself or inside one of its own groups.
common_refusal_tree_group_name_required: Every group you add needs a name.
common_refusal_tree_group_not_found: A group in the tree is no longer in this project. Reload the page and try again.
common_refusal_unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
common_refusal_value_list_applied: The result of this round is already in the proposal.
common_refusal_value_list_changed: The proposal has a newer version than the round rated, so the result no longer applies.
common_refusal_value_list_empty: This proposal has no values to rate.
common_refusal_value_list_in_round: These values are already in a round that is not closed.
common_refusal_value_list_not_found: This value list was not found, or its element is not in the model.
common_refusal_value_list_settled: This proposal is settled. Revise it before you put its values to a round.
common_refusal_value_list_unchanged: The round kept every value, so the proposal stays as it is.
common_refusal_value_not_in_round: This value is not in the round.
common_refusal_value_number_not_allowed: The values of a coded text element have no number.
common_refusal_value_number_not_integer: The numbers of an ordinal element must be whole numbers.
common_refusal_value_number_required: Each value of an ordinal or scale element needs a number.
common_refusal_value_round_items: A value round takes its value lists from the Details page.
common_refusal_values_not_allowed: Only coded text, ordinal and scale elements have proposed values.
common_step_closed: This step is closed. You can still read it, but you cannot add anything.
details_addressed_saved: The objection is marked as addressed.
details_by_architecture: Version {version}, proposed by an architecture group
details_by_terminology: Version {version}, proposed by a terminology group
details_cardinality_hint: The widest any use case in scope needs.
details_codes_description: A second terminologist reviews every new version before the group answers it.
details_codes_in_review: Codes are proposed and wait for review.
details_codes_proposed: The codes wait for review by a second terminologist.
details_empty: Elements come here once a closed round includes them in the model.
details_empty_title: No elements in the model yet
details_objection_label: What is wrong with this proposal?
details_propose_description: Everyone answers the new version again.
details_proposed: The proposal is sent to the group.
details_review_pending: Waits for review by a second terminologist.
details_review_skip_label: Why is there no second terminologist?
details_review_structure_changed: The structure changed, so the codes need a new version.
details_settled: The proposal is settled and on the element.
details_sources_differ: The existing models differ in type.
details_system_uri_invalid: Type the URI of the code system, such as http://snomed.info/sct.
details_tree_description: Put groups inside other groups, set how often each group occurs, and mark sub-blocks and registration elements. A sub-block can be reused and is not a model on its own. A registration element, such as an identifier, a start date or an author, is part of the model but may be hidden from care providers. Everyone answers the new version again.
details_tree_link_invalid: Type a link that starts with http:// or https://.
details_tree_link_needs_title: Name the sub-block the link points to.
details_tree_name_required: Give the new group a name.
details_tree_proposed: The tree is sent to the group.
details_value_round_added: The values are in round {number}. Open it from the Rounds page.
details_value_round_applied: Version {version} holds the values round {number} kept
details_value_round_closed: Result of the values in round {number}
details_value_round_draft: The values wait in round {number}, which is not open yet
details_value_round_due: Round {number} with the values waits to be closed
details_value_round_open: The values are rated in round {number}
details_value_round_start: Rate the values in a round
details_value_set_invalid: Type a full URL, starting with https:// or http://.
export_csv_commas: The CSV files are UTF-8 text with commas between the values.
export_csv_excel: A spreadsheet program set to Dutch expects semicolons. In Excel, open the file with Data, From Text/CSV, and choose Comma as the delimiter.
export_csv_libreoffice: LibreOffice Calc asks for the separator when it opens the file: tick Comma.
export_elements_description: One row per element with its data types, cardinality, sources, CKM link, the CKM links of merged duplicates and the outcome of each round.
export_mind_map_description: The elements in the model as a FreeMind mind map (.mm), which Freeplane and XMind open.
export_purpose: Download the elements, the mind map and the ratings for the modellers and the study report.
export_ratings_description: One row per rating from the closed rounds, with a random participant code instead of a name.
invite_invalid: This invitation was used, revoked or has expired. Ask the facilitator of the project for a new one.
invite_next: Sign in with the e-mail address the invitation was sent to. Signing in accepts the invitation.
invite_pending: You are invited to take part in the project {project}.
mail_invitation_body:
You are invited to take part in the cdm-plenum project {project}, in the stakeholder group {group}.

Open this link to accept the invitation:

{url}

The invitation expires after {hours} hours.
members_copy_failed: The link could not be copied. Copy it from here: {url}
members_group_name_required: Enter a name for the group.
members_groups_description_participant: The panel of this project: each group with its expert type and the number of participants. Names are not shown.
members_groups_description_participant_n: The panel of this project: each group with its expert type, the number of participants and their names.
members_invitations_caption: Invitations of the project, newest first
members_invitations_description: An invitation link works once and expires after {hours} hours. Without e-mail, copy the link and pass it on yourself.
members_invite_email_invalid: Enter an e-mail address such as name@example.org.
members_invite_group_required: Choose the group the participant joins.
members_invite_not_sent: {email} is invited. No e-mail was sent: copy the link in the list and pass it on.
members_invite_sent: {email} is invited. The invitation e-mail is sent.
members_leave_confirm_body: To take part again, you need a new invitation from the facilitator.
members_leave_description: You lose access to the project at once. Your ratings in closed rounds stay in the results.
members_names_help: On: participants also see the names, never the e-mail addresses. Who wrote or rated what stays hidden.
members_names_hidden: Participants no longer see who is in each group.
members_names_label: Participants can see who is in each stakeholder group
members_names_shown: Participants now see who is in each group.
members_private_help: Working alone first gives more and more varied ideas. You reveal the board on the element board.
members_private_label: Participants first see only their own elements, until you reveal the board
members_private_off: Participants see every element from the start.
members_private_on: Participants first see only their own elements.
members_private_revealed: You revealed the board, so this setting no longer applies.
members_purpose: The stakeholder groups of the project, who takes part in each, and the open invitations.
members_rater_current: You rate as a member of {group}.
members_rater_description: Join one group to rate in the rounds. Your ratings count like a participant's, and you stay facilitator.
members_rater_group_required: Choose the group you rate in.
members_rater_joined: You now rate as a member of {group}.
members_rater_left: You no longer rate in a stakeholder group.
members_rater_locked: While a round is open, you cannot move to another group or leave your group.
members_rater_none: You are not in a stakeholder group, so you do not rate.
members_rater_title: Rate as a member of a group
members_remove_description: You can only remove a group without participants and without open invitations.
members_rename_description: Give the group {group} a new name. Participants see it at once.
projects_check_comments_none: No comments on the scope yet
projects_check_detail_codes: {settled} of {total} elements have settled codes; open codes do not hold up the hand-off
projects_check_detail_none_in_model: No element is in the model yet.
projects_check_detail_proposed: {proposed} of {total} elements have a structure proposal
projects_check_first_look_empty: Put elements from existing models on the list first.
projects_check_group_asked: Participants check the groups: {checked} of {participants} done.
projects_check_group_todo: You or a modeller put each element in a group; participants check it.
projects_check_models_many: {models} models imported: {elements} elements on the list.
projects_check_models_none: Import the models that already describe the concept.
projects_check_models_one: 1 model imported: {elements} elements on the list.
projects_check_no_elements: No elements on the board yet
projects_check_panel_done: The minimum panel is invited or has joined
projects_check_panel_many: Invite {count} more people for the minimum panel
projects_check_panel_one: Invite 1 more person for the minimum panel
projects_check_reveal: Reveal the board, then merge the duplicates people marked.
projects_check_round_draft: Round {number} is set up but not open yet
projects_check_round_due: Round {number} has passed its closing date. Close it to see the results.
projects_decided_bar: {included} in the model, {excluded} not in the model, {open} still open, {unrated} not rated yet
projects_decided_empty: No elements on the board yet.
projects_description: The projects you take part in, with your role and the phase each project is in.
projects_empty_facilitator: Create a project for the clinical concept your group works on.
projects_empty_participant: You see a project here once you accept an invitation. Ask the facilitator of your project for one.
projects_header_no_scope: The scope is not written yet.
projects_home_change_until: You can change your scores until
projects_home_turn_detail: Check the structure of the elements
projects_home_turn_first_look: Your turn: look at what already exists
projects_home_turn_rate_values: Your turn: rate the values of round {number}
projects_name_description: For example the concept, such as Blood pressure. At most {max} characters.
projects_name_required: Enter a name for the project.
projects_new_description: A project covers one clinical concept. You become its facilitator.
projects_phase_confirm_next: Move the project on to {phase}? Participants then see the task of that phase.
projects_phase_confirm_previous: Move the project back to {phase}? Participants then see the task of that phase again.
projects_phase_moved: The project is now in the phase {phase}.
projects_recap_added_files: added by {people} participants and from a CSV file
projects_recap_detail_title: Detail: the structure of the model
projects_settings_purpose: Choices that apply to the whole project.
projects_status_elements_none: No elements on the board yet.
projects_status_round_awaiting: The closing date of round {number} has passed. Close the round to see the results.
projects_task_discover: Add the elements you think the concept needs.
projects_task_discover_none: You have not added an element yet.
projects_task_handoff: The list is agreed. There is nothing more for you to do.
projects_task_rate: Rate whether each element of round {number} belongs in the data model.
projects_task_rated_all: You rated every element of round {number}.
projects_task_round_closing: Round {number} takes no more ratings. The results follow when the facilitator closes it.
projects_task_scope: Read the scope and comment where you miss something.
projects_task_wait: There is nothing for you to do now. Your next task shows here when a round opens.
rounds_agreement_help: The share of scores that must fall in one band.
rounds_bottom_band_help: Scores from the lowest score up to and including this score count as "does not belong in the model".
rounds_by_participant_caption: Each participant's ratings in this round. Only the facilitator sees this table, because the round allows it.
rounds_card_details_intro: You rate only whether the element belongs in the model. These details are settled in a later step. Is one of them wrong? Flag it and give a reason.
rounds_card_details_summary: Data type, cardinality and values (not rated)
rounds_card_details_summary_flagged: Data type, cardinality and values (not rated, flagged by you: {count})
rounds_change_class_a_description: The model stays as it is; the group checks it against current practice.
rounds_change_class_b_description: A small change to an existing model, such as one extra element or a clearer description.
rounds_change_class_c_description: A large change to an existing model, such as several new elements or a new structure.
rounds_change_class_d: D, large change or new model
rounds_change_class_d_description: A new model, or a change so large that the model is almost new. New projects start in this class.
rounds_change_class_help: The class sets the minimum panel, after the Nictiz management agreements for zibs.
rounds_close_due: The closing date has passed, so nobody can rate any more. Close the round to calculate the outcomes.
rounds_close_explained: Closing calculates the outcome of each element under the rule of the round, and everyone in the project then sees the results. You cannot undo this.
rounds_close_not_due: You can close this round after its closing date. Until then, participants can still rate.
rounds_closes_at_future: The closing date must be in the future.
rounds_closes_at_help: In your time zone, {zone}. After this moment nobody can rate.
rounds_closes_at_required: Enter the closing date and time.
rounds_elements_board_empty: The board has no elements yet. Add them on the element board first.
rounds_elements_help: Participants rate every element you select.
rounds_elements_required: Choose at least one element to rate.
rounds_empty_facilitator: Start the first round when the board holds the candidate elements.
rounds_empty_participant: The facilitator has not opened a round yet. You can rate once a round is open.
rounds_fixed_after_opening: Once the round is open, the elements, the rule, the closing date and this setting can no longer change.
rounds_flag_reason_data_type: Why is the data type wrong?
rounds_flag_reason_help: Required. Only the facilitator sees your flags. At most {max} characters.
rounds_flags_intro: Participants flag a data type, cardinality or values they think is wrong. These details are settled in a later step.
rounds_flags_none: No participant has flagged a detail.
rounds_minimum_help: Leave a field empty to use the default of the change class.
rounds_minimum_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}, or leave the field empty.
rounds_minimum_legend: Minimum per expert type for this project
rounds_minimum_reason_heading: Reason for the project's own minimum
rounds_minimum_reason_help: Needed when you set a count of your own. The decision report shows it next to the class defaults. At most {max} characters.
rounds_minimum_reason_required: Give a reason for the change.
rounds_new_description: Choose the elements, the rule and the closing date. The round stays a draft until you open it.
rounds_new_description_next: The elements without consensus in round {number} are selected. The round stays a draft until you open it.
rounds_one_at_a_time: One round runs at a time. Close round {number} before you start a new one.
rounds_open_below_minimum: The panel is below the minimum for this change class:
rounds_open_fixed: After opening, the elements, the rule, the closing date and the setting for who rated what can no longer change.
rounds_open_in_decide: You open the round once the project is in the decide phase. Move it on from the project's overview.
rounds_open_intro: When you open the round, participants can rate until the closing date.
rounds_open_reason_help: The reason is stored with the round and shown in the decision report. At most {max} characters.
rounds_open_reason_label: Reason for opening below the minimum
rounds_open_reason_required: Give a reason to open the round below the minimum.
rounds_open_reveals_board: Opening the round also reveals the board: every participant then sees all elements, without authors.
rounds_open_shortfall_hint: The panel is below the minimum. You can still open the round: you give a reason when you open it.
rounds_opened_below_minimum: Round {number} is open below the minimum. The reason is saved.
rounds_opposition_help: The largest share of scores allowed in the other band.
rounds_overview_intro: Check your ratings. Select an element to go back to its card and change it.
rounds_panel_caption: Participants who joined, per expert type, next to the minimum
rounds_panel_intro: Change class {changeClass}. The minimum panel is a guideline: you can open a round below it when you give a reason.
rounds_panel_locked: The change class and the minimum are fixed, because a round has opened.
rounds_panel_meets_minimum: The panel meets the minimum for every expert type.
rounds_percentage_invalid: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, with at most two decimals.
rounds_proposal_rule_default: Proposed by at least two participants
rounds_proposal_rule_help: Round 1 ends with an open question for missing elements. Participants see this rule before they propose, and you apply it when you add proposals to the board. Leave it empty for no rule. At most {max} characters.
rounds_proposals_empty: Nobody has proposed an element yet.
rounds_proposals_intro: Proposals from the open question of round 1. Add a proposal to the board when it meets the rule, so the next round can rate it.
rounds_propose_heading: Is an element missing? Propose it
rounds_propose_intro: Name an element that is not in the list. Other participants never see your proposals. The facilitator sees them, with your name only if the facilitator can see your ratings.
rounds_propose_name_required: Enter a name for the element.
rounds_propose_none: You have not proposed an element.
rounds_purpose: The Delphi rounds in which the group rates the elements, and the results of closed rounds.
rounds_rate_autosave: Your answers are saved as you go. You can change them until the round closes.
rounds_rate_band_bottom: Does not belong in the model
rounds_rate_group_scores: How the group scored in round {number}
rounds_rate_intro: The data model holds every element that one of the use cases in scope needs, whichever standard implements it later, not only a minimal core.
rounds_rate_join_group: Join a stakeholder group on the Settings page to rate.
rounds_rate_keys: Keys: {first} to {last} choose a score, U is unable to rate, N goes to the next element and P to the previous one.
rounds_rate_keys_move: Keys: N goes to the next element and P to the previous one.
rounds_rate_no_group: As facilitator you rate only as a member of one stakeholder group. Choose your group on the Settings page.
rounds_rate_not_open: This round is no longer open, so you cannot change your ratings.
rounds_rate_previous_distribution: Scores for {name} in round {number}, from everyone and per stakeholder group
rounds_rate_previous_figures: Median, band shares and all scores
rounds_rate_question: Does this element belong in the data model, for any use case in scope?
rounds_rate_reason_help: Saved when you leave the field. In the next round other participants see it without your name. At most {max} characters.
rounds_rate_reason_help_unrated: Choose a score or "unable to rate" first. The reason is saved with it.
rounds_rate_score_lowest: {score}, does not belong in the model
rounds_rate_visible_title: The facilitator can see your ratings
rounds_raters_hidden: Nobody can see who gave which rating, the facilitator included.
rounds_raters_visible: The facilitator can see who gave which rating. Other participants cannot.
rounds_response_caption: Participants per stakeholder group: invited (joined before the round closed), started (at least one answer) and completed (an answer for every element).
rounds_result_no_groups: No stakeholder group has 3 or more scores on this element, so only the overall result shows.
rounds_results_after_close: The results show once the round is closed.
rounds_results_caption: Results per element: the outcome, the median, the distribution of the scores and the answers
rounds_results_intro: Open Details for every score, the share in each band and the result per stakeholder group. A stakeholder group with fewer than 3 scores counts only in the overall result.
rounds_rule_default_explained: The default is a scale from 1 to 9 with the rule of the COMET Handbook: an element goes in the model when at least 70% score 7 to 9 and at most 15% score 1 to 3, and stays out of the model the other way round. You can change the scale and every threshold until the round opens.
rounds_rule_error_agreement_not_above_ha: Agreement must be more than 50% and at most 100%.
rounds_rule_error_bands_outside_scale: The bands must lie within the scale.
rounds_rule_error_bands_overlap: The top band must start above the end of the bottom band.
rounds_rule_error_opposition_not_below_a: Opposition must be lower than agreement.
rounds_rule_error_scale_not_integer: The scale and the bands use whole numbers.
rounds_rule_error_scale_too_short: The highest score must be above the lowest score.
rounds_rule_excluded: Not in the model when at least {agreement}% score {bottom} and at most {opposition}% score {top}.
rounds_rule_in_words_pending: Correct the values above to see the rule.
rounds_rule_included: In the model when at least {agreement}% score {top} and at most {opposition}% score {bottom}.
rounds_rule_otherwise: Otherwise: no consensus. "Unable to rate" does not count toward the percentages.
rounds_score_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
rounds_sees_raters_help: Participants see this setting before they rate. Other participants never see who gave which rating. Leave it off unless your study needs it.
rounds_sees_raters_label: The facilitator may see who gave which rating
rounds_setup_details: Setup of this round: scale, rule and panel
rounds_setup_question: Participants answer for each element: "Does this element belong in the data model, for any use case in scope?"
rounds_snapshot_caption: Participants per expert type when the round opened, next to the minimum that applied
rounds_snapshot_reason: Reason for opening below the minimum
rounds_top_band_help: Scores from this score up to and including the highest score count as "belongs in the model".
rounds_value_close_explained: Closing calculates the outcome of each value under the rule of the round, and everyone in the project then sees the results. You can then apply the kept values to each proposal. You cannot undo closing.
rounds_value_list_applied: Applied as version {version} of the proposal.
rounds_value_list_apply_done: {name}: version {version} of the proposal now waits for answers.
rounds_value_list_changed: The proposal changed after the round, so this result no longer applies.
rounds_value_list_unchanged: Every value stays in the list.
rounds_value_lists_add: Add a value list from its element on the Details page.
rounds_value_open_in_detail: You open the value round once the project is in the Detail phase. Move it on from the project's overview.
rounds_value_overview_intro: Check your ratings. Select a value to go back to its card and change it.
rounds_value_rate_now: Rate the values of round {number} now
rounds_value_rate_question: Does this value belong in the element's value list, for any use case in scope?
rounds_value_results_caption: Results per value: the outcome, the median, the distribution of the scores and the answers
rounds_value_rule_default_explained: The default is a scale from 1 to 9 with the rule of the COMET Handbook: a value stays in the list when at least 70% score 7 to 9 and at most 15% score 1 to 3. A value without consensus leaves the list as well. You can change the scale and every threshold until the round opens.
rounds_value_rule_excluded: Left out of the list when at least {agreement}% score {bottom} and at most {opposition}% score {top}.
rounds_value_rule_included: Kept in the list when at least {agreement}% score {top} and at most {opposition}% score {bottom}.
rounds_value_rule_otherwise: Otherwise: no consensus, and the value leaves the list too. "Unable to rate" does not count toward the percentages.
rounds_value_setup_question: Participants answer for each value: "Does this value belong in the element's value list, for any use case in scope?"
scope_model_type_action_description: Something that was done for the patient, such as a procedure or a dose of medication given.
scope_model_type_cluster_description: A reusable part that other models include, such as a body site or a device.
scope_model_type_evaluation_description: A judgement about the patient, such as a diagnosis, a problem or a risk.
scope_model_type_instruction_description: A request to do something later, such as a medication order or a referral.
scope_model_type_observation_description: Something measured or observed about the patient, such as a blood pressure or a lab result.
scope_out_of_scope_description: What the group leaves out on purpose.
scope_purpose: The scope statement of the concept: what it covers, its use cases, what is out of scope and the sources.
scope_source_label_description: For example a guideline, a standard or a form. At most {max} characters.
scope_source_label_required: Enter a title for the source.
scope_source_remove_body: {label} leaves the list of sources. You can add it again later.
scope_source_url_description: Optional. The address starts with https:// or http://.
scope_source_url_invalid: Enter a web address that starts with https:// or http://.
scope_use_cases_description: The situations in which the data is recorded or used.
shell_dev_sign_in_empty: There are no active accounts yet.
shell_dev_sign_in_note: For development and tests only. Choose a person to sign in as them. No e-mail is sent.
shell_sign_out_failed: Signing out did not work. Try again.
sign_in_check_inbox: If this address may sign in, a sign-in link is on its way to {email}. The link works once and expires after {minutes} minutes.
sign_in_error_failed: The sign-in link could not be sent. Try again.
sign_in_error_invalid_link: This sign-in link was used or has expired. Ask for a new one.
sign_in_error_not_invited: This e-mail address has no invitation. Ask the facilitator of your project for one.
sign_in_intro: Enter your e-mail address and you get a link to sign in. To sign in for the first time, you need an invitation to a project.
